providers.title: The completed cone over a surface
providers.scope: For a smooth integral projective surface X over C with H ample and globally generated, the section ring T(X,H) is a domain finite over C[x_0,x_1,x_2], and its completion R(X,H) at the vertex is a complete Noetherian local domain of dimension three with residue field C, finite over C[[x_0,x_1,x_2]].
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The regular model and normality
providers.scope: The total space of O_X(-H), base-changed to C[[x_0,x_1,x_2]], is a regular integral scheme W, proper over Spec R(X,H) and isomorphic to the punctured spectrum off the zero section, with Gamma(W, O_W) = R(X,H); hence R(X,H) is normal.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Small Cohen–Macaulay modules are free over the power series ring
providers.scope: A small Cohen-Macaulay module over R(X,H) is free over C[[x_0,x_1,x_2]], has positive rank, and is locally free on the punctured spectrum.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Extension to the regular model
providers.scope: A small Cohen-Macaulay module of rank r gives a torsion-free sheaf E on W whose restriction P to the exceptional surface is torsion-free of rank r; the pushforward of E is trivial of rank N = rh off the exceptional plane and restricts to f_*P on it.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Chern classes on the plane through Hilbert polynomials
providers.scope: Rank, c_1 and ch_2 of coherent sheaves on P^2, defined as coordinates of the Hilbert polynomial, are additive and transform correctly under twists; c_1 >= 0 for sheaves of rank zero and for globally generated sheaves.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Harder–Narasimhan filtrations
providers.scope: Assume (CS). Every torsion-free sheaf of positive rank on a smooth projective surface with an ample H has a filtration with torsion-free semistable factors of strictly decreasing slopes.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Balancing by elementary modifications
providers.scope: Assume (CS). A torsion-free sheaf on an integral Noetherian scheme, with torsion-free restriction to a Cartier divisor that is a smooth projective surface with ample conormal bundle, can be modified along the divisor so that the Harder-Narasimhan slopes of the restriction lie in an interval of length at most one.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: A variance inequality
providers.scope: If L' is torsion-free on an integral Noetherian scheme, trivial of rank N off a Cartier divisor D = P^2 whose ideal restricts to O(1), then F = L'|_D satisfies 2N ch_2(F) >= c_1(F)^2.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: One semistable factor
providers.scope: Assume (CS), (NF) and (BI). For a finite map f: X -> P^2 of degree h with f^*O(1) = O_X(H) and a torsion-free semistable sheaf G on X, v(f_*G) <= 1/4 - (K_X^2 - 2c_2(X))/(12h).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The numerical obstruction
providers.scope: Assume (CS), (NF) and (BI). If the completed cone R(X,H) over a smooth projective complex surface, with H ample and globally generated, has a small Cohen-Macaulay module, then K_X^2 - 2c_2(X) <= 6H^2.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The complete quadrangle on the blown-up plane
providers.scope: Assume (BL). On the plane blown up at four points in general position, the six joining lines and the four exceptional curves form a simple normal crossing divisor with fifteen nodes, linearly equivalent to -2K_B, and K_B^2 = 5.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: A Kummer cover and its local form
providers.scope: For a prime n, the normalization of the blown-up plane in the field obtained by adjoining n-th roots of five ratios of the linear forms is a smooth surface of degree n^5 over the base, locally of the form t -> t^n along the branch curves.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Chern numbers of the cover
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: An ample globally generated polarization
providers.scope: Assume (BL), (EU) and (CS). The divisor H = 3J - E on the cover is ample and globally generated, with nH = pi^*(-K_B), H^2 = 5n^3 and K_X^2 - 2c_2(X) = n^3(n^2 - 10).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: A complete local domain without a small Cohen–Macaulay module
providers.scope: Assume (CS), (NF), (BI), (BL) and (EU). For n = 7, R(X,H) is a three-dimensional complete Noetherian normal local domain containing C, with residue field C, without a nonzero finitely generated module of depth three; the same holds for the uncompleted local ring at the vertex (Corollary 6.2).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review
